item.title: Herefordshire farmer raises £44k for charity with Prince William’s support
item.description: Sam Stables, a sheep farmer from Herefordshire and founder of We Are Farming Minds, has raised more than £44,000 through a 142-mile charity walk from Ross-on-Wye to London. The post Herefordshire farmer raises £44k for charity with Prince William’s support appeared first on Farmers Guide.

item.title: KFC boosts spending on British chicken to almost £100m a year
item.description: KFC has pledged that by the end of 2026, 35 percent of its chicken will be sourced from British farms. To facilitate this, the chain is boosting its annual spend on British chicken by approximately £10 million, bringing the yearly total spend to almost £100 million. The post KFC boosts spending on British chicken to almost £100m a year appeared first on Farmers Guide.

item.title: Dog attacks on livestock increased by 10% in 2025
item.description: Farm animals valued at £1.95 million were severely injured or killed in dog attacks in 2025, representing a 10% increase compared to the previous year, according to NFU Mutual. The post Dog attacks on livestock increased by 10% in 2025 appeared first on Farmers Guide.

item.title: Detection of first UK potato late blight strain highlights resistance risk
item.description: A first UK finding of the potato late blight strain, EU_43_A1, resistant to two crucial groups of blight chemistry, underscores the need to continue following industry guidance on alternating and mixing blight actives and modes of action in programmes.
